final: WITH per_order AS (SELECT o.order_id, COUNT(i.invoice_number) AS invoice_count FROM Orders AS o LEFT JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY o.order_id), totals AS (SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS total_invoices FROM per_order), average_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(1.0 * p.invoice_count / NULLIF(t.total_invoices, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM per_order AS p CROSS JOIN totals AS t), filtered AS (SELECT p.invoice_count, 1.0 * p.invoice_count / NULLIF(t.total_invoices, 0) AS ratio FROM per_order AS p CROSS JOIN totals AS t CROSS JOIN average_ratio AS a WHERE 1.0 * p.invoice_count / NULLIF(t.total_invoices, 0) > a.avg_ratio) SELECT SUM(invoice_count) AS sum_invoice_count, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(ratio - a.avg_ratio) AS avg_difference FROM filtered CROSS JOIN average_ratio AS a
